'''Tayala Lees''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] who ran the [[Ayanee Farming Cluster]], a group of six [[silvergrass]] [[Farm/Legends|farms]]. Under orders from the [[Office of Agricultural Export]], Lees funneled ten percent of her farms' crops to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
